notes: All signatures and keys are public test fixtures, never operational credentials.

Use task/dispatch_v1.json signing vectors for DispatchRejectV1, DispatchAcceptV1, SignedHandraiseRootV1, DispatchTicketV1 and DispatchRecordV1. They bind nonce 1; a rotation has installed a different current key at nonce 2.
Resolve proof keys by participant_type, operator_address and the signed service_authorization_nonce. A retained key never authorizes a new live request or admission.
ProofKeyUnavailable is not evidence of misconduct. Authoritative key loss within a required proof window must fail closed without attributing fault.
